test_case_name: Accept all cookies via mobile banner

intents.intent: Click the 'Acconsento' button to accept all cookies (mobile)
And then check that the cookie banner is dismissed and cookies are accepted

test_case_name: Accept all cookies via desktop banner

intents.intent: Click the 'Acconsento' button to accept all cookies (desktop)
And then check that the cookie banner is dismissed and cookies are accepted

test_case_name: Close the cookie banner

intents.intent: Click the button with id 'cookie-chiudi' to close the cookie banner
And then check that the cookie banner is no longer visible

test_case_name: Open Privacy - Cookie policy from mobile banner

intents.intent: Click the 'Più opzioni' link to open Privacy - Cookie policy (mobile)
And then check that the Privacy - Cookie policy page is displayed

test_case_name: Open Privacy - Cookie policy from desktop banner

intents.intent: Click the 'Più opzioni' link to open Privacy - Cookie policy (desktop)
And then check that the Privacy - Cookie policy page is displayed

intents.intent: Type $name into the input with placeholder 'Cosa posso fare per te oggi?'
